item.title: [−1] India–US trade talks have 'reached a plateau', finance minister says; compromise 'very difficult'
item.description:
Sitharaman said further give-and-take would be very difficult, after a US law allowed tariffs of up to 100% on big buyers of Russian oil. Talks continue. Escalating from last week's reports of delays.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Engineering exports exposed

Why it matters: A stalled deal keeps US tariff risk hanging over Indian exporters and weighs on foreign investor sentiment and the rupee.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
